subject: control-center-l0
purpose: Human-use validation of the universal Control Center summary.

useCases.taskPrompt: Guarda questa pagina come se stessi controllando lo stato del sistema. Dimmi che cosa è disponibile, se devi fare qualcosa e quanto sono recenti le informazioni.
expectedOutcome: Understands the current situation as regular
Recognizes available capabilities and their scope
Can identify recency without technical detail
criticalMisinterpretations: Believes a decision or intervention is required
Treats availability as certification or approval
Needs technical detail to understand the summary
passCriteria: Correctly states no action is required
Identifies what is available in plain language

useCases.taskPrompt: Guarda questa pagina. Che cosa resta utilizzabile? C'è qualcosa che richiede attenzione? Chi dovrebbe intervenire?
criticalMisinterpretations: Believes the whole ecosystem is blocked
Believes the reader is necessarily the responsible actor
passCriteria: Separates usable information from item requiring attention
Does not infer a global failure

useCases.taskPrompt: Guarda questa pagina. Che cosa non può avanzare e che cosa invece resta disponibile?
expectedOutcome: Understands a specific activity is blocked pending a decision
Does not attribute approval authority to the Control Center
criticalMisinterpretations: Believes the whole system is unavailable
Believes the Control Center can approve or remove the block
Believes the blocked activity may proceed
passCriteria: Does not attribute decision authority to the interface

useCases.taskPrompt: Guarda questa pagina. Quanto sono recenti le informazioni che vedi e puoi ancora usarle?
expectedOutcome: Recognizes the view as the last known state
Does not interpret it as freshly checked
criticalMisinterpretations: Believes all information is invalid because the latest check is unavailable
passCriteria: Identifies last-known nature of the state

useCases.taskPrompt: Senza aprire i dettagli tecnici, dimmi dove ti trovi, che cosa fa TRAMA in una frase, come sono collegati Arena, Atlas e Docente OS e dove andresti per approfondire.
expectedOutcome: Identifies the surface as TRAMA Control Center
Explains TRAMA purpose in one non-technical sentence
Recognizes both Arena to Atlas and Arena to Docente OS relationships without treating Atlas as mandatory
Identifies an appropriate destination for further detail
criticalMisinterpretations: Treats Atlas as the mandatory intermediary between Arena and Docente OS
Attributes curriculum authority to Atlas or the Control Center
Cannot identify where to go for more detail
passCriteria: Explains TRAMA purpose without repository or DevOps vocabulary
Describes the branching ecosystem relationship correctly
Identifies a relevant destination for further detail
